        style 10 fill:#85bbf0,stroke:#5d82a8,color:#000000
        11["Health server<br/>[Component: Go, net/http]<br/>Serves /livez and /readyz."]
        style 11 fill:#85bbf0,stroke:#5d82a8,color:#000000
        12["Tick loop<br/>[Component: Go]<br/>Runs the refresh, Reaper,<br/>Admission, and Launcher steps<br/>in sequence."]
        style 12 fill:#85bbf0,stroke:#5d82a8,color:#000000
        13["Stack<br/>[Component: Go]<br/>Registers and deregisters the<br/>custom stack. Gives the<br/>dispatch_paused value."]
        style 13 fill:#85bbf0,stroke:#5d82a8,color:#000000
        14["Poller<br/>[Component: Go]<br/>Lists the first page of<br/>scheduled jobs at each poll<br/>interval."]
        style 14 fill:#85bbf0,stroke:#5d82a8,color:#000000
        15["Inventory<br/>[Component: Go]<br/>Lists Orchard workers and<br/>VMs. Selects owned VMs by<br/>name prefix."]
        style 15 fill:#85bbf0,stroke:#5d82a8,color:#000000
        16["JobStates<br/>[Component: Go]<br/>Gets the Buildkite job states<br/>of owned VMs in batches.<br/>Records the observation<br/>times."]
        style 16 fill:#85bbf0,stroke:#5d82a8,color:#000000
        17["Matcher<br/>[Component: Go]<br/>Pure function. Converts job<br/>agent tags to exactly one VM<br/>profile, or to a mismatch<br/>reason."]
        style 17 fill:#85bbf0,stroke:#5d82a8,color:#000000
        18["Admission<br/>[Component: Go]<br/>Pure function. Selects the<br/>jobs that fit the free<br/>capacity and the unmatched<br/>jobs to fail."]
        style 18 fill:#85bbf0,stroke:#5d82a8,color:#000000
        19["Launcher<br/>[Component: Go]<br/>Reserves jobs, gets job<br/>acquisition tokens, and<br/>creates VMs."]
        style 19 fill:#85bbf0,stroke:#5d82a8,color:#000000
        20["Reaper<br/>[Component: Go]<br/>Pure decision function and<br/>executor. Deletes VMs,<br/>finishes jobs, and extends<br/>reservations."]
        style 20 fill:#85bbf0,stroke:#5d82a8,color:#000000
        21["Stacks client<br/>[Component: Go]<br/>Narrow interface over<br/>github.com/buildkite/stacksapi."]

        22["Orchard client<br/>[Component: Go]<br/>Narrow interface over the<br/>Orchard pkg/client package."]

        23["Telemetry<br/>[Component: Go, OpenTelemetry SDK]<br/>Configures the OpenTelemetry<br/>meter, tracer, and slog<br/>bridge."]

      end
